ns2:course.label: Population Health
ns2:course.description: This course covers a range of topics including concepts of populations, social behavior, chronic disease, health care team, patient safety, statistics, big data, PCMH, palliative care, quality, compensation, and mobile health technologies. No graduate credit. 2 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: This course is restricted to students enrolled in the MD program at Carle Illinois College of Medicine.
